title: Coral and the Veil
author: Vesper Dravenmoor
blurb: Edmund Amberdale, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
